I've answered in the thread under your message: it was the **Southgate** depot.

On 2025-09-03 Priyanka posted in this channel that labels had stalled and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked by door 4. Later that day she said Southgate had cleared the backlog and closed the incident.

I couldn't find a street address or site ID for Southgate. The channel doesn't give one, and I found no Tansley account files you have access to. If you need the exact address for the call, Priyanka is the one to ask, since she was running the incident.
